# Pure Nutrix Official Search Engine Crawler Directives (100% Optimized)
# Allows Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot, and other major search engines to crawl all pages and assets.

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /checkout
Disallow: /cart

# Explicit rules for major search crawlers
User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /
Crawl-delay: 1

User-agent: Googlebot-Image
Allow: /assets/
Allow: /images/

User-agent: Bingbot
Allow: /
Crawl-delay: 1

User-agent: Applebot
Allow: /

# XML Sitemap reference
Sitemap: https://purenutrix.in/sitemap.xml
